title: Bulleogi for server side
description: Adds an item in Minecraft that allows you to place blocks that exist only as blocks... for server side
body:
Adds an item in Minecraft that allows you to place blocks that exist only as blocks.
Adds items for blocks that normally don't have them, including: 
- Frosted Ice
- Bubble Columns and Water (Up/Down)
- Air
- Nether Portal
- End Portal
- End Gateway

You can obtain items using:

- Frosted Ice
- Bubble Columns and Water (Up/Down)
- Air
- Nether Portal
- End Portal
- End Gateway
  
List of available commands:

- /bulleogi <power>
- /bulleogi set_air
- /bulleogi nether_portal_spawner
- /bulleogi frosted_ice
- /bulleogi end_portal_spawner
- /bulleogi end_gateway_spawner
- /bulleogi bubble_column_and_water_up
- /bulleogi bubble_column_and_water_down
